title: Senior Java Backend Engineer
description:
### **Position Overview:**

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Java Backend Engineer with 15+ years of relevant experience in designing, developing and operating high-performance enterprise backend systems. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Java 17+, Spring Boot 3.x, PostgreSQL, Redis, microservices and event-driven architecture.

The role involves owning the backend of a high-volume enterprise platform responsible for receiving, validating, storing and processing millions of transactions per month while maintaining strict data integrity, complete audit trails and low latency. Candidates must have hands-on experience designing, building and operating production systems at this scale and be able to explain performance bottlenecks, scalability challenges and the solutions implemented.

This position requires on-site work in Dubai, UAE, for a minimum period of six months.

  

### **Key Responsibilities:**

### **Backend Service Design & Development**

* Design, develop and maintain scalable Spring Boot microservices with clear domain boundaries and well-defined service responsibilities.
* Implement strict input validation, consistent error handling using RFC 7807-style responses and reliable transactional behaviour.
* Ensure business rules, data integrity and validation are enforced at the backend level.
* Build and maintain production-grade services capable of processing millions of transactions per month.

### **Database Design & Optimisation**

* Design and maintain PostgreSQL schemas for high-volume transactional systems.
* Implement effective indexing, table partitioning and query optimisation strategies.
* Analyse and optimise database queries using EXPLAIN and performance profiling techniques.
* Manage database migrations, transaction isolation, connection pooling and zero-downtime schema changes.
* Maintain reliable performance for databases containing hundreds of millions of rows.

### **Caching & Distributed Coordination**

* Implement Redis for caching, idempotency keys, rate limiting and distributed coordination.
* Design and manage distributed locks, queue or stream patterns and hot-path lookups.
* Define caching strategies, eviction policies, consistency requirements and failure-handling mechanisms.
* Monitor Redis performance, memory usage, persistence and clustering behaviour.

### **Event-Driven Processing & Messaging**

* Develop reliable asynchronous processing pipelines using Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, Redis Streams or equivalent technologies.
* Implement outbox patterns, retry mechanisms and dead-letter handling.
* Prevent transaction loss and duplication through reliable message-processing and idempotency strategies.
* Apply event sourcing, CQRS or append-only ledger patterns where appropriate.

### **API Development & Integration**

* Design and maintain secure, versioned REST APIs using OpenAPI-first development practices.
* Integrate backend services with Flutter applications, API gateways, middleware and external partner systems.
* Work with WSO2, Kong, Azure API Management or equivalent integration platforms.
* Implement OAuth2, OpenID Connect, webhook integrations and secure partner communication.
* Maintain consistent API contracts, authentication and authorisation mechanisms.

### **Reliability, Monitoring & Performance**

* Implement structured logging, metrics and distributed tracing across backend services.
* Define service-level objectives (SLOs) and support production reliability initiatives.
* Conduct load testing, capacity planning and performance optimisation.
* Diagnose production issues using telemetry and monitoring tools.
* Participate in incident response and improve service resilience in Microsoft Azure environments.

### **Security & Audit Management**

* Implement role-based access control and secure authentication and authorisation mechanisms.
* Maintain reliable audit trails and robust data-integrity controls.
* Apply secure secrets management and appropriate security controls for regulated environments.
* Follow secure coding practices, including relevant OWASP recommendations.

### **Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Develop unit, integration and contract tests for backend services.
* Participate in rigorous code reviews and enforce engineering quality standards.
* Provide reproducible test environments, fixtures and documentation for functional and performance testing teams.
* Ensure backend services meet reliability, security and performance requirements.

### **Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead technical discussions and contribute to backend architecture decisions.
* Document architecture decision records (ADRs), technical designs and functional specifications.
* Mentor engineers and promote clean code, maintainability and engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and reliable enterprise solutions.

### **Must-Have Skills & Experience**

* **Experience:** 15+ years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, with demonstrable hands-on ownership of production Java backend systems processing millions of transactions per month or more.
* **Java & Spring Boot:** Strong expertise in Java 17+, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, Spring Security, Spring Cache, Bean Validation and Spring Boot Actuator.
* **Java Fundamentals:** Strong understanding of concurrency, memory management, multithreading and JVM performance tuning.
* **PostgreSQL:** Advanced expertise in database schema design, indexing, partitioning, EXPLAIN-driven query optimisation, transaction isolation and connection pooling.
* **Redis:** Production experience with caching, idempotency, distributed locks, Redis Streams, persistence, clustering and failure scenarios.
* **Messaging & Asynchronous Processing:** Hands-on experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, Redis Streams or equivalent technologies.
* **Event-Driven Architecture:** Understanding of event sourcing, CQRS, outbox patterns and reliable asynchronous processing.
* **API Development:** Expertise in REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications, API versioning, OAuth2, OIDC, webhooks and third-party integrations.
* **API Gateways & Middleware:** Experience with WSO2, Kong, Azure API Management or similar technologies.
* **Cloud & DevOps:** Practical experience with Microsoft Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code.
* **Monitoring & Observability:** Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK or Azure Monitor.
* **Testing & Engineering Practices:** Strong understanding of unit testing, integration testing, contract testing, code reviews and secure software development.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical decisions and collaborate with distributed teams.
* **On-Site Availability:** Willingness and availability to work on-site in Dubai, UAE, for a minimum of six months.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, supply chain, fintech, government or other compliance-sensitive environments.
* Knowledge of structured-data standards such as EDI, HL7/FHIR or ISO 20022.
* Experience with WSO2 Enterprise Integrator, WSO2 API Manager or comparable middleware platforms.
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL extensions such as pgvector, PostGIS or TimescaleDB.
* Experience with read replicas, logical replication and large-scale database operations.
* Understanding of computer-system validation and audit requirements, including GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11 or ISO 27001 controls.

**Experience:** 15+ Years

**On-Site Requirement:** Minimum 6 Months

**Location:** Dubai, UAE

**Salary:** As per company norms
